paper_title: Searching for Ultralight Dark Matter Conversion in Solar Corona using Low Frequency Array Data
notes: Paper reports a new 95% C.L. observed upper limit on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon ~1e-13 over frequency range 30-80 MHz (mass 1.24e-7 to 3.31e-7 eV), from resonant DPDM-photon conversion in the solar corona observed with LOFAR. The exclusion curve is shown in Fig. 4 but no numerical table is provided; the two emitted points encode the text-stated ~1e-13 level across the stated mass range (actual curve has zig-zag structure spanning roughly a factor of a few around 1e-13). The paper also derives an axion-photon coupling limit (Fig. 10, gaγγ ~1e-9 to 1e-8 GeV^-1) but it does not exceed CAST/astrophysical bounds; the dark photon result is the primary new limit. DM density assumed 0.3 GeV/cm^3; limit scales as (rho_A'/rho_DM)^0.5. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.6, 2))
